author: Reuters
description:
65-year-old Ghislaine Magoarou was 9 when her teacher, Brother Gabriel Girard, raped her in a classroom in northwest France. The incident marked the start of a months-long cycle of abuse at the now-shuttered Catholic school.

Magoarou and other survivors are recounting their trauma ahead of Pope Leo's visit to France on September 27, where he is expected to address the sexual abuse crisis in France's Catholic Church and continue the work of his predecessor, Pope Francis, by meeting with survivors. Francis took steps to address clerical abuse, although some groups have criticized them as insufficient.
